Method of Attack: Distributed through malicious websites submitted to URLhaus
Emotet spread via emails carrying documents with malicious macros that download and execute the payload from compromised websites
Emotet started as a banking trojan and evolved to deliver other malware and check victim IP blacklists
Impacted Systems: Windows systems targeted by Emotet, Gozi, and GandCrab malware
Attack Vector: Malicious URLs hosted on compromised websites
Indicators of Compromise: Close to 100,000 websites taken down for malware distribution
About 380,000 malware samples collected by URLhaus over ten months
